summary: Enhance your financial management skills with our Sage Intacct training course. Master essential tools and techniques for effective financial oversight.
lede: Sage Intacct training helps finance and accounting professionals configure cloud-based financial operations and manage multi-entity reporting. You’ll practice setting up dimensional general ledger structures, automating accounts payable and receivable workflows, and producing dimensional reports and role-based dashboards to support financial oversight and the month-end close.
audienceIntro: This comprehensive training is structured for finance and accounting professionals who need to configure, manage, and optimize cloud-based financial operations.
modules: Sage Intacct Architecture and Dimensional General Ledger
Managing Accounts Receivable and Order Entry
Financial Report Writer and Dimensional Analysis
System Controls, Smart Rules, and Smart Events
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of accounting principles, including General Ledger operations, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and bank reconciliations. Prior experience with legacy accounting software or entry-level exposure to Sage Intacct is beneficial but not strictly required. No programming or coding skills are necessary, as all configurations are performed through the user interface.
